data.reason: The Open New Account form requires choosing an existing account to transfer the $100 minimum deposit from. I wanted to record this as a per-run input ("fundingAccountNumber") but no discovery value was supplied, and the form's default (12345) has a negative balance / $0.00 available, so using it could fail or fund the new account from an overdrawn account. Opening the account is irreversible, so I do not want to guess.
